message.content: The drive from San Francisco to Los Angeles is roughly 380–400 miles (about 610–640 km) depending on the exact route you take. Under normal conditions—no major traffic jams or detours—a typical trip takes around **6 hours**. If you’re traveling during rush hour or on holidays, you might add an extra hour or two, so plan for 7–8 hours to be safe.
